subject: Re: Kickoff: Lasagna layer-stacking for the translation tier
body:
Dmitri,

Plan as requested.

Staffing: Linnea 60% as tech lead — she's already got the fairseq integration building, including the CUDA kernel compilation for the lightconv/dynamicconv layers (the cuda_function_gen step is scripted now). Kaia 40% on architecture-search design — which layer-type-per-position configs we actually sweep, since exhaustive is hopeless. Milan 40% on the eval harness and baseline parity.

Compute: interim experiments fit on 64 Titan A100s best-effort. For the endgame: we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation — 512 GPUs for the week of 2026-06-01 — for the final architecture-sweep training runs; Ines confirmed the slot. That week covers 24 configs at 120k updates each on both language pairs, per Kaia's sizing.

Note the sweep must finish in that week — Vulcan has a maintenance window Jun 22-24 and I don't want any stragglers anywhere near it with our Jun 12 readout in between.

Santiago
